title: Seventeen Years and One Missing Row
subtitle: 科技与创新 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 科技与创新（科学与技术·科技发展与信息技术）
meta: 主题语境：科技与创新（科学与技术·科技发展与信息技术）　|　核心词汇：data　|　正文 334 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 data 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1964 the researcher ① collected a data that no laboratory in the country would have accepted, and he said the collecting was the whole of the study. The ② data, meaning the observations and not the table, ran seventeen years and stayed unchecked; data, he said, is the only thing in a study that is judged by how long it is left unverified.

Every ③ data in that file had the same missing row against it, and the ④ data at the end, meaning the one they kept for the final report and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever checked twice. Data, his assistant said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to collect; the researcher said the collecting is the part that fills seventeen years.

The statistician meant the other thing entirely: she said ⑤ the data was the whole of the argument, meaning the figures and not the observations. The ⑥ data, meaning the figures and not any of that, is the only thing in an argument that everybody quotes and nobody reads; data, she said, is either something you collect or the only word that means both an observation and a figure. She said the figure is the part they remember.

By 1972 the ⑦ data had become a line in a summary, and the summary had become an argument about the missing row. The ⑧ data of the whole thing, the researcher wrote in May, was one file and seventeen years of collecting; data, he said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to collect. She said the collecting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ data I remember is the one at the end, which was published in 1985 and is still described as the longest in the country. A ⑩ data, the assistant said in 1987, is the only thing that improves by being collected; every data, she said, is a figure that has agreed to look like an observation. She said the figure was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 数据；资料（指档案里的那一组）
B. n. 数据（指那些观测记录本身，与那张表格相对）
C. 固定搭配：collect a data 收集一组数据
D. n. 数据（指留给最终报告用的那一组）
E. n. 数据；资料（抽象总称，指一份档案里的全部材料）
F. n. 数据（指摘要里写到、被引用的那一组）
G. n. 数据；数字（指争论中被引用的那些数字）
H. n. 数字（抽象总称，指人人引用却无人细读的那些）

answers.why: collect a data 意为“收集一组数据”，1964 年研究员收集了一组全国没有一家实验室肯接受的数据。
data 意为“数据”，指那些观测记录本身而不是那张表格，它历经十七年而未被核对。
data 意为“数据”，指那份档案里每一组数据，每一组都有同一行缺失对着它。
data 意为“数据”，指留给最终报告用的那一组，是唯一有人核对过两次的。
data 意为“数据、数字”，指争论中被引用的那些数字，统计学家说这些数字就是那场争论的全部。
data 意为“数字”，指人人引用却无人细读的那些而不是别的，是争论里人人都引用、却无人去读的东西。
data 意为“数据”，指摘要里写到、被引用的那一组，到 1972 年这组数据成了摘要里的一行。
data 意为“数据、资料”，研究员五月写道，整件事的资料是一份档案和十七年的收集。
data 意为“数据”，我记得的是末尾那一组，1985 年发表，至今仍被说成全国历时最久的一组。
data 为抽象总称，助手 1987 年说，一组数据是唯一会因为被收集而变得更好的东西。
